newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse sluggish, summer blamed.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse sluggish, summer blamed.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse on Monday was subdued with summer blamed for the waning interest and low volumes, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 26.8 million kroons with the Talse 0.77 percent lower at 250.21.
"There is almost no volume at all and a summer trend of mixed prices, but most stocks are stable," one dealer said.
"However, it looks like summer has come early, so autumn may as well too...the market might pick up again after the banks release their half year results," he added.
Hansapank was the most active to shed 2.31 kroons for a close at 127.55 kroons after registering trade of 6.7 million kroons.
The free market turned over 5.5 million kroons, with EMV, a construction company, the most active by a small margin.
EMV saw trade of 1.5 million kroons to lose 35 kroons after closing at 640 kroons.
